protocol.ablation: Missing specialists execute capable generic implementations. No ablation directly returns failure. All learned ablations share the exact same fitted address weights so accuracy changes cannot be attributed to retraining luck.
protocol.calibration: Source coverage versus unsupported-module rejection, restricted to past calibration. Unknown requested fields and withdrawn sources remain separate final-reader checks.
protocol.controls: All strategies receive identical current sources and permitted past labels, and have a maximum of two evidence reads. Learned heading and single-source classifiers each receive hidden=32, 240 steps, batch=32. Retrieval controls require no gradient training; their index construction and retained labeled examples are counted. No equal-FLOPs claim.
protocol.cost_contract: Report actual model parameters, optimizer, index, source text, event/cache serialization, setup time, address runtime, actual evidence reads/bytes, parse work and event replay. Cache setup and retained source evidence are never free; microsecond timings are not general capability evidence.
protocol.event_cell: Exact current-state projection; generic fallback replays the same supplied event journal.
protocol.event_scope: Explicit constructed scenarios: incomplete ingestion of the first three authentic steps, correction to the complete source block, then withdrawal. These are not historical document revisions or production event logs.
protocol.interpretation: Same-repository method development, not independent confirmation. Deterministic typed readers are not learned generative memory. Zero ablation loss is an admissible result. No compression, production, general understanding or spontaneous emergence claim.
protocol.meta_cell: Learned heading addressing with literal module resolution; generic fallback uses full-text BM25 with the same module registry.
protocol.procedure_cell: Exact source-bound compiled ordered checklist; generic fallback parses and executes the same checklist at query time.
protocol.semantic_cell: Exact source-bound declaration cache; generic fallback parses the same evidence at query time.
protocol.task_scope: Authored requests about actual module declarations and actual numbered procedure blocks. Procedure execution advances a bounded checklist cursor; it causes no external effect.
protocol.time_contract: Phase 0 trains on phase-0 train prompts; later phases train on past non-calibration queries and newly available canonical sources. Threshold calibration uses past calibration prompts (phase 0 uses its own). New-phase test outputs do not select weights, thresholds or type structure.
